title: Week 3
priceNote: Prices are estimates from typical Aldi and Publix shelf prices and do not include tax. Two lunches and two dinners come from your freezer this week.
allergyNote: Nothing on this plan contains tree nuts or fish. Peanut butter is often made in plants that also handle tree nuts. If your allergy is strict, check the label for a 'may contain tree nuts' line.
weekendNote: Festival days. Leftovers waiting for you: a smash burger bowl and a portion of Peruvian chicken. The freezer is clear, so week 4 starts fresh.

mon.heads: Move one carnitas portion to the fridge tonight for tomorrow's tacos.

wed.heads: Marinate the Peruvian chicken this morning. Tonight, move the last carnitas and both chili bowls to the fridge.

prep.title: Sunday prep
prep.makes: 3 teriyaki lunches, 3 hash breakfasts, oat clusters, 6 hard-boiled eggs
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the sweet potato, sausage, pepper and onion for the hash on a sheet pan and roast 25 minutes.
Cook 2 cups of rice. Save 1½ cups in the fridge for Thursday's fried rice.
Cook the teriyaki chicken in a skillet and microwave the broccoli.
Drop the oven to 325°F and bake the oat clusters for 15 to 18 minutes.
Air-fry 6 eggs at 270°F for 15 minutes, then move them to ice water.
Pack 3 teriyaki bowls and 3 hash containers.

prep.title: Wednesday morning
steps: Stir the marinade together and coat the chicken thighs. Refrigerate.
Blend or finely chop the green sauce and refrigerate it.
Tonight, move the last carnitas portion and both chili bowls from the freezer to the fridge.

oat-clusters.name: Honey cinnamon oat clusters
steps: Heat the oven to 325°F.
Microwave the honey, peanut butter and oil for 20 seconds and stir smooth.
Toss with the oats, cinnamon and salt until everything is coated.
Press it flat on a lined sheet pan and bake 15 to 18 minutes, turning once halfway.
Cool completely, then break into clusters and store in a jar.

yogurt-bowl.name: Berry yogurt power bowl
steps: Spoon the yogurt into a bowl.
Top with the berries and their juice, then the oat clusters.
Add the peanut butter and a drizzle of honey.
yogurt-bowl.tip: Good fuel about 90 minutes before pickleball.

sweet-potato-hash.name: Sweet potato sausage hash with eggs
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the sweet potato, pepper and onion with the oil and spices on a sheet pan and pinch the raw sausage over the top in small pieces.
Roast 25 minutes, stirring once, until the potatoes are browned and the sausage is cooked.
Split into 3 containers.
Each morning, reheat a portion and top it with 2 eggs fried in 3 minutes.

hb-eggs.name: Air-fryer hard-boiled eggs
steps: Put the eggs straight into the air fryer basket.
Cook at 270°F for 15 minutes.
Move them to a bowl of ice water for 5 minutes, then refrigerate.

teriyaki-bowl.name: Honey teriyaki chicken bowl
steps: Stir the soy sauce, honey, garlic, ginger and 2 tbsp water together.
Brown the chicken in the oil over high heat for 6 to 7 minutes.
Pour in the sauce and let it bubble 3 to 4 minutes, until it turns glossy and coats the chicken.
Microwave the broccoli bags.
Pack rice, broccoli and chicken into 3 containers with sesame oil and green onion on top.

smash-bowl.name: Smash burger bowl with special sauce
steps: Stir the yogurt, ketchup, mustard and pickle brine together for the sauce.
Heat the cast iron until very hot. Add the beef balls with a slice of onion on each and smash them flat with a spatula.
Season and cook 2 minutes until crusty, flip, add cheese and cook 1 minute more.
Pile romaine, tomatoes and pickles into bowls, top with the patties and drizzle with sauce.
smash-bowl.tip: The second bowl is a weekend lunch.

carnitas-street-tacos.name: Carnitas street tacos
steps: Crisp the carnitas in the hot cast iron with a splash of its juices, 4 to 5 minutes without stirring.
Warm the tortillas in the dry pan for 30 seconds a side.
Stir a squeeze of lime and a pinch of salt into the yogurt.
Fill with carnitas, onion and cilantro, then finish with lime and the yogurt.

freezer-chili.name: Turkey chili from the freezer
steps: Move both bowls from the freezer to the fridge the night before.
Microwave 3 to 4 minutes, stirring halfway.
Top with cheese, green onion and a spoon of yogurt.

carnitas-fried-rice.name: Carnitas fried rice
steps: Crisp the carnitas in the hot pan with the oil for 3 minutes, then push it to the side.
Scramble the eggs in the empty space and break them up.
Add the garlic and peas for 1 minute, then the cold rice. Press it flat and let it crisp 2 minutes.
Toss with the soy sauce, sesame oil and green onions.
carnitas-fried-rice.tip: Cold rice from Sunday fries best. Quick dinner after Thursday pickleball.

peruvian-chicken.name: Peruvian chicken with green sauce
steps: Mix the juice of 2 limes, 4 garlic cloves, the spices, soy sauce, 1 tbsp oil and the salt. Coat the chicken and marinate 30 minutes or all day.
For the green sauce, blend or finely chop the cilantro, jalapeños, feta, yogurt, the last garlic clove and the juice of 1 lime. Salt to taste.
Toss the sweet potato wedges with the rest of the oil and a pinch of salt. Air-fry at 400°F for 15 minutes.
Air-fry the chicken at 380°F for 18 to 20 minutes, or roast at 425°F for 25, until charred at the edges.
Serve with the wedges and plenty of green sauce.
peruvian-chicken.tip: This week's new one, and a dinner for two. The green sauce is the star, and it is great on everything.

chicken-fajitas.name: Sheet-pan chicken fajitas
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the chicken, peppers and onion with the oil and spices on a sheet pan in one layer.
Roast 18 to 20 minutes, then switch to broil for 2 minutes to char the edges.
Squeeze the lime over everything.
Warm the tortillas and set out cheese, yogurt, avocado and cilantro so everyone builds their own.
